summary: Tested 4 features: live address search (Google Places + OSM backup), Pin address later, appliance-aware fixes, and multiple rentals. Backend: all 13 tests in the new test_iter7_features.py pass, and the 54 onboarding regression tests (iterations 3-6) also pass. Google Places autocomplete returns source 'google' with geo:null. /place returns full geo with source 'google'; a bad place_id -> 503. q<3 -> 422. Geocode falls back to OSM Photon (source 'osm', Mountain View result); gibberish -> 422. Multi-rental: new:true creates a rental with onboarding:false and the first-setup rental is untouched. Updating by property_id works; another host -> 404. GET /onboarding?property_id returns rooms and first_setup:false. Rooms attach to the target rental. complete?property_id works. /properties returns rooms_count and items_count. Clearing demo data also deletes rooms/items of demo rentals. Pin later: unverified -> pinned gives verified:true and source 'osm' is kept. /inventory returns the room title. POST /issues rejects an item from another rental (400). GET /issues/{id}.item has brand/model/room. Diagnose guessed item_id and property_id when the rental was named in the note. The AI draft mentions the model. UI at 390x844, all PASS: Pin on map -> /onboarding?pid&pin=1 auto-shows Google suggestions ('Powered by Google') -> pick -> map card with drawn-pin fallback -> Save address -> back to Rentals with toast 'Pinned on the map.' and the pin button gone. Add a rental -> 'Add a rental' title with back button and no skip link -> type -> suggestions -> pick -> Change reopens suggestions -> confirm -> rooms?pid=new -> add Kitchen -> review -> Finish -> celebration 'Back to rentals' -> card reads '1 room · 0 tagged items'. Demo rentals show rooms buttons (5 cards); adding a room to Tahoe gives '1 room · 0 tagged items'. Find address returns the OSM result and auto-picks it; for gibberish it shows an error and 'Save as typed'. Snap: once the right rental is selected, the 'Is it this one?' card shows 'Samsung RF28R7351SR refrigerator · Kitchen'. The snap-item-select chips (Not listed + item) work, and Track issue -> the issue screen shows issue-appliance. The 'Link a tagged appliance' link shows when nothing is guessed. Regression: demo login still redirects to /onboarding (not completed or skipped); Fix-it and Bench tabs load. MAIN GAP: for a host with several rentals, a note that doesn't name the rental ('The fridge is leaking water onto the floor') gets no appliance guess. The AI returns property_id null, the frontend defaults to props[0] (a rental with no items), and the fridge in the other rental is never offered. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Completing an EXTRA rental also sets users.onboarding_complete=true (onboarding_routes.py:495). For a host who skipped first setup, finishing a 2nd rental makes GET /onboarding return complete:true while first_setup is still true and the first rental has onboarding_complete:false. So the Rentals SetupCard (properties.tsx:73 checks ob.complete) disappears even though first setup is unfinished. Only set the user flag when the target property has onboarding:true.

An update with an empty name replaces the existing nickname with the street (e.g. 'Lake cabin' -> '2 Market St'). The UI pre-fills the nickname, so this only happens if the host clears the field or the API is called directly. Consider keeping existing.name when name is blank on update.
There is no region bias: '1600 Amphitheatre Parkway' also suggests 'Mountain View, Cagayan De Oro…' (Philippines). Consider includedRegionCodes:['us'] or a locationBias.

ui_bugs.component: Snap results – appliance guess with several rentals
ui_bugs.issue: If the note doesn't name a rental, diagnose returns property_id:null and item_id:null. autoFill (snap.tsx:41-45) then picks the remembered rental or props[0], and guessItem only searches that rental. Result: the tagged Samsung fridge in 'TEST Apple house' is not suggested and there is no 'Is it this one?' card or link (the default rental had no items). Fix: when the AI gave no property_id, name-match across ALL items. If exactly one rental has a match, choose that rental and that item.

integration_issues.issue: review.tsx:48 calls router.replace('/(tabs)/properties') from a pushed stack (Rentals -> rooms -> room -> review). This puts a second tabs navigator on top of the stack: the DOM then has 2 copies of property-card-*-rooms-summary, and Back goes to the old rooms screen. Use router.dismissTo('/(tabs)/properties') or dismissAll() + navigate.

issues: The eyebrow reads 'SET UP · STEP 1 OF 3' and the 3-step progress shows even though Pin on map is a single step. Hide Steps or relabel in pin/edit mode.
'Link a tagged appliance' stays visible above 'Done' after the edit panel with the Appliance chips is open, which is redundant.

action_items: Snap: when diagnose has no property_id, guess the item across all rentals' inventory and switch the property to the rental owning the single match (snap.tsx autoFill/guessItem). Optionally do the same server-side in diagnose_issue.
onboarding_routes.py complete(): only set users.onboarding_complete when the target property is the first-setup one (onboarding:true).
review.tsx enter(): for a non-first rental use router.dismissTo('/(tabs)/properties') instead of replace, so the tabs navigator isn't stacked twice.
Optional: keep the existing nickname on blank-name updates; add a US region bias to autocomplete; hide 'Step 1 of 3' in pin mode.
critical_code_review_comments: tests/test_bullpup_api.py (legacy) needs EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported, and 10 of its tests get 403 because the demo host is gated on onboarding by design. This is a stale suite, not a regression.
AddressSearch debounce and sequence guard are solid. The session token is renewed after the details call. The OSM credit text is shown when the source is osm.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass; the Snap guess fails when the rental isn't named)

seed_data_creation: Created test_ob_*/test_ui7_* users; all removed afterwards (36 users, 409 docs). The demo host was only logged in; onboarding was not completed or skipped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 for sequential state (pytest.ini forces xdist). Google Places is ON, Geocoding is OFF (OSM fallback), Static Maps is OFF (drawn pin). To reproduce the Snap guess gap: a host with 2 rentals, the fridge tagged in the 2nd, and a note that doesn't name the rental.
